# usd-caches

usd-caches is the caching layer of Omniverse Content Services: a local cache (Hub) for each workstation or compute node, a shared content cache (ovcontentcache, OVCC) in front of S3, Azure Blob Storage, GCS, and Nucleus, and a shared derived-data cache (ovderivedcache, OVDC) for derived data shared across workers.

## Primary Docs

- README.md: product overview, interface contracts, build and deployment, NGC releases, licensing
- AGENTS.md: coding-agent guide, expert role, ground rules, NGC links, repo layout, skill routing
- skills/usd-caches-expert/SKILL.md: expert skill for choosing, building, deploying, configuring, calling, and validating caches
- docs/index.rst: Sphinx docs entrypoint

## Core Workflows

- Choosing caches: skills/usd-caches-expert/references/choosing-caches.md
- Local cache: skills/usd-caches-expert/references/local-cache/README.md
- Shared content cache: skills/usd-caches-expert/references/shared-content-cache/README.md
- Shared derived-data cache: skills/usd-caches-expert/references/shared-derived-cache/README.md
- Kit and ovstorage hub_cache integration: skills/usd-caches-expert/references/integrations.md
- Related experts (usd-content-workspace, ovstorage, ovpackage, ovlive): skills/usd-caches-expert/references/related-experts.md

## Prebuilt Releases

- Hub collection: https://catalog.ngc.nvidia.com/orgs/nvidia/omniverse/collections/hub-workstation-cache/-
- Caching Services collection (OVCC as "UCC", OVDC as "DDCS"): https://catalog.ngc.nvidia.com/orgs/nvidia/omniverse/collections/omniverse-cache-services/-
- OVCC Helm chart: https://catalog.ngc.nvidia.com/orgs/nvidia/teams/omniverse/helm-charts/ovcontentcache
- OVDC Helm chart: https://catalog.ngc.nvidia.com/orgs/nvidia/teams/omniverse/helm-charts/ovderivedcache
- Helm repository: https://helm.ngc.nvidia.com/nvidia/omniverse (requires an NGC API key)

## Constraints

- Agents explain and recommend by default; build, install, or deploy only when asked.
- In a cluster, both shared caches deploy through their Helm charts on Kubernetes.
- The shared content cache's values.yaml is its only supported configuration interface.
- shared-derived-cache/ is produced by an automated public export; change it upstream.
